## Summary

Describe the change and its user or operational impact.

## Validation

- [ ] `make format`
- [ ] `make check`
- [ ] Focused tests added or updated where behavior changed
- [ ] AI-DLC requirements, stories, and construction artifacts reviewed and updated as applicable

## Safety and operations

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private Telegram identifiers, invite links, or
      raw sensitive logs are included.
- [ ] Development Telegram operations remain mock-only.
- [ ] Deployment, IAM/OIDC, workflow, configuration, or release-policy impact
      is documented.
- [ ] Required CODEOWNERS review was requested.
